findings.summary: The non-arrow pager button selector is dead for the current pager markup.
findings.consequence: The scoped style block keeps a page-specific branch that cannot affect observable behavior, making future pager styling harder to reason about.
findings.evidence: The owned selector at line 1952 targets `.littb_pager .ctrl li:not(.arrows) > button`, with a paired disabled rule below. In the current pager template, only the previous/next controls are real buttons and they live under `li.arrows`; the non-arrow pager actions are anchors with `role="button"`, so this selector does not match current DOM.
findings.recommendation: Delete the non-arrow button selector and its disabled companion, or convert those pager actions to actual `<button type="button">` elements and keep one selector that matches the intended semantic markup.
